description: tangent-cylinders-cut's tool moved a quarter of a tolerance (1e-7) across the contact, into the target (d > 0) and away from it (d < 0): within the tolerance the pose is the contact's, and the result is the target whole with every id kept, as tangent-cylinders-cut is (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the tangent ruling on the target's wall, as at the contact (tangent-cylinders-cut); Arris keeps the wall whole — within the tolerance the touch removes no material
